summary: Abstract base class BaseDBConnection providing settings-based auth, SSH tunnelling, and lifecycle hooks. Extended by IcebergConnectionBase and legacy Ibis connection classes.
extension_points: Subclass and implement abstract methods/properties to add a new backend
lifecycle_notes: Predates the Backend protocol; Iceberg still inherits from it, Ibis new-style does not
documentation_hooks: Extension authors building new catalog backends should start here
risks: Dual contract surface: Backend protocol (structural) and BaseDBConnection (nominal) coexist
open_questions: Will legacy connection hierarchy be consolidated into the Backend protocol?
